dog.description_text:
Hi, I’m Oakley! 🐾

I’m so happy you’re interested in adopting me! My foster moms say I’m super handsome, so I guess that’s pretty great news for you.

A little about me: I’m potty trained and know to do my business outside. Although, I did get a little too excited once and accidentally peed on my mom’s bed. She wasn’t thrilled, but I gave her a kiss, and all was forgiven. 😉

I LOVE going on walks and runs! The Big Apple is so cool, and there are SO many smells to explore. I have lots of energy, so I love to be outside and active. My foster moms have actually had to take up running just to keep up with me!

Meeting people on my walks is one of my absolute favorite things. I’m a friendly guy who loves meeting everyone, and I’m not aggressive toward people at all. I’m also pretty easygoing at home. The vacuum, doorbell, and hustle and bustle of city life don’t bother me, so I’m happy living in a busy neighborhood without making a fuss over every little noise!

I really like other dogs, too, although sometimes I get a little too excited and can’t help but bark. I haven’t met any kids before, but they seem super interesting, and I’d love the chance to get to know them!

I can’t wait to meet you and hopefully find my forever home. Maybe we can go on a run, explore the city, and then cuddle up after a long day. Sounds like a pretty great life to me!

Love,
Oakley <3

﻿Oakley is approximately 1y 1m 14d old and is fully grown at 34 pounds. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
